assets.name: Star
assets.description: A faceted solid star with any number of points, standing upright on two of them.

assets.name: Rounded Box
assets.description: A box with true rounded edges, the best starting point for blockouts and kitbashing.

assets.name: Capsule
assets.description: A pill-shaped capsule: a cylinder with hemispheres on both ends.

assets.name: Rounded Cylinder
assets.description: A cylinder with smoothly rounded rims, like a puck, a can or a pedestal.

assets.name: Torus Knot
assets.description: A smooth tube winding around a torus, forming a (p, q) knot like the trefoil.

assets.name: Platonic Solid
assets.description: One of the five regular polyhedra, from the tetrahedron to the icosahedron, resting on a face.

assets.name: Helix
assets.description: A round tube coiled into a helix, like a spring or a spiral ornament.

assets.name: Heart
assets.description: A puffy, rounded heart standing upright on its point.

assets.name: Arrow
assets.description: A 3D arrow lying on the ground, flat like a floor marker or round like a gizmo.

assets.name: Screw
assets.description: A wood screw with a real helical thread, a pointed tip and a flat, pan or hex head.

assets.name: Bolt
assets.description: A hex bolt with a chamfered head and a helical thread along the end of its shank.

assets.name: Nut
assets.description: A hex nut with chamfered edges and a threaded hole, with any number of sides.

assets.name: Washer
assets.description: A flat washer with softly rounded edges, to go under a nut or bolt head.

assets.name: Gear
assets.description: A spur gear with involute-style teeth, a hub and an optional lightened web.

assets.name: Spring
assets.description: A compression spring with closed, ground-flat ends so it stands on its own.

assets.name: Chain
assets.description: A chain of interlocking oval links lying in a gentle curve, with adjustable twist.

assets.name: Pipe
assets.description: A run of hollow pipe with smooth bends and bolted flanges at the joints.

assets.name: Cable
assets.description: A power cable sagging between two plugs, with adjustable slack and thickness.

assets.name: Stairs
assets.description: A flight of solid steps with a handrail, straight or turning at a landing.

assets.name: Spiral Staircase
assets.description: A spiral staircase of wedge treads winding around a central column, with a handrail.

assets.name: Building
assets.description: A multi-story building with a grid of windows, an entrance and a roof ledge.

assets.name: Wall
assets.description: A straight wall, plastered or bricked, with evenly spaced window or door openings.

assets.name: Window
assets.description: A framed window with glass panes divided by mullions, standing on its sill.

assets.name: Door
assets.description: A door in its frame, with a paneled, flat or glazed leaf and lever handles.

assets.name: Column
assets.description: A column with a base and capital, classical with fluted shaft or modern and plain.

assets.name: Arch
assets.description: A round stone arch on two piers, built from wedge-shaped voussoirs and a keystone.

assets.name: Roof
assets.description: A pitched or flat roof with overhanging eaves, to put on top of a building.

assets.name: Fence
assets.description: A straight run of fence, white pickets or horizontal rails between square posts.

assets.name: Ladder
assets.description: A straight wooden ladder with two rails and round rungs, standing upright.

assets.name: Table
assets.description: A wooden table with a rectangular or round top and straight, tapered or pedestal legs.

assets.name: Chair
assets.description: A wooden dining chair with an optional slatted back and seat cushion.

assets.name: Shelf
assets.description: A wooden bookcase with any number of shelves and compartments.

assets.name: Crate
assets.description: A slatted wooden crate with corner posts, a plank floor and adjustable wear.

assets.name: Barrel
assets.description: A staved wooden barrel bound with iron hoops, with a bulge you can adjust.

assets.name: Bottle
assets.description: A hollow glass bottle with a long neck and an optional cork.

assets.name: Mug
assets.description: A glazed ceramic mug, hollow inside, with an optional handle.

assets.name: Vase
assets.description: A hollow turned vase whose belly, neck and lip are shaped with a few sliders.

assets.name: Book Stack
assets.description: A stack of hardcover books in assorted sizes and cover colors.

assets.name: Lamp
assets.description: A desk or floor lamp with a fabric shade and a glowing bulb.

assets.name: Coin Stack
assets.description: A leaning stack of gold coins with raised rims.

assets.name: Dice
assets.description: A rounded game die with 4, 6, 8, 12 or 20 faces; the six-sided one has pips.

assets.name: Rock
assets.description: A lumpy, faceted boulder with cracks and a flat underside that sits on the ground.

assets.name: Rock Cluster
assets.description: A group of differently sized rocks huddled together on the ground.

assets.name: Low-Poly Tree
assets.description: A stylized low-poly tree with a tapered trunk, a few branches and chunky leaf clumps.

assets.name: Bush
assets.description: A round, leafy shrub made of hundreds of small leaves around a dense core.

assets.name: Grass Patch
assets.description: A round patch of soil covered in grass blades that bend in the wind.

assets.name: Flower
assets.description: A single flower on a gently curved stem with two leaves and a ring of petals.

assets.name: Mushroom
assets.description: A fairy-tale toadstool with a red, white-spotted cap on a stout white stem.

assets.name: Terrain
assets.description: A mountainous landscape tile with grassy valleys, rocky slopes and snowy peaks.

assets.name: Ocean
assets.description: A square of open sea whose rolling waves move as the animation plays.

assets.name: Cloud
assets.description: A puffy cartoon cloud with a flat underside, made of merged round billows.

assets.name: Planet
assets.description: A small world with continents, mountains, craters and oceans, shown as a globe.

assets.name: Crystal Cluster
assets.description: A cluster of faceted glowing crystals growing out of a rocky base.

assets.name: Gem
assets.description: A large sparkling gemstone in brilliant, emerald or princess cut, standing on its point.

assets.name: Donut
assets.description: The classic donut with wavy icing, colorful sprinkles and an optional bite.

assets.name: Balloon
assets.description: A shiny party balloon with a tied knot and a curly string that rests on the ground.

assets.name: Sculpt Sphere
assets.description: A quad sphere with evenly sized faces and no poles, ideal for sculpting and remeshing.

assets.name: Suzanne
assets.description: Blender's monkey head, subdivided and smoothed into a dense mesh ready to sculpt.

assets.name: Human Male
assets.description: A realistic adult male body in an A-pose with clean quad topology, ready to sculpt.

assets.name: Human Female
assets.description: A realistic adult female body in an A-pose with clean quad topology, ready to sculpt.

assets.name: Stylized Male
assets.description: A stylized male body with simplified forms, a base for cartoon and game characters.

assets.name: Stylized Female
assets.description: A stylized female body with simplified forms, a base for cartoon and game characters.

assets.name: Human Hand
assets.description: A realistic human hand with relaxed fingers, for sculpting hands and anatomy studies.

assets.name: Sculpt Head
assets.description: A neutral realistic human head and neck with eyes, the starting point for a bust.

assets.name: Studio Backdrop
assets.description: A seamless curved backdrop with soft key, fill and rim lights and a camera framing a subject at its center.

assets.name: Turntable
assets.description: A camera and soft lights that orbit a platform in front of a dark backdrop, looping every 120 frames.

assets.name: Car Paint
assets.description: Glossy metallic car paint with sparkling flakes under a deep clear coat.

assets.name: Holographic
assets.description: Iridescent holographic foil, rainbow thin film swirling over dark polished metal.

assets.name: Marble
assets.description: Polished white marble with layered dark veins and a hint of translucency.

assets.name: Toon
assets.description: Cel shaded cartoon look with crisp light bands, a highlight and a rim light.

assets.name: Sculpting Clay Warm
assets.description: Warm matte modeling clay that shows every form, with darkened creases.

assets.name: Sculpting Clay Grey
assets.description: Neutral grey matte clay for judging forms while sculpting, with darkened creases.

assets.name: Skin
assets.description: Soft translucent skin with natural tone variation, subtle redness and fine pores.

assets.name: Gold
assets.description: Polished yellow gold with subtle smudges and uneven polish.

assets.name: Copper
assets.description: Warm polished copper with soft smudges and uneven polish.

assets.name: Chrome
assets.description: Mirror-like chrome plating with faint smudges.

assets.name: Brushed Steel
assets.description: Brushed stainless steel with anisotropic highlights and fine streaks.

assets.name: Rust
assets.description: Painted metal eaten by rust, with chipped paint edges and bare metal showing through.

assets.name: Clear Glass
assets.description: Perfectly clear glass with crisp reflections and refraction.

assets.name: Frosted Glass
assets.description: Sandblasted frosted glass that blurs what's behind it into a soft glow.

assets.name: Ice
assets.description: Cold blue ice with frosted cracks and trapped air bubbles inside.

assets.name: Water
assets.description: Clear water with a slight blue tint and gentle ripples on its surface.

assets.name: Wood
assets.description: Oiled hardwood with growth rings on its end grain and long grain on its sides.

assets.name: Concrete
assets.description: Cast concrete with air pockets, mottled tone and weathered water stains.

assets.name: Ceramic Glaze
assets.description: Glossy glazed ceramic whose glaze pools darker in hollows, with fine iron speckles.

assets.name: Velvet
assets.description: Plush velvet with a dark core and a bright soft sheen along its edges.

assets.name: Neon
assets.description: Glowing neon tube with a white-hot core, saturated edges and a glassy sheen.

assets.name: Snowy Terrain
assets.description: Mountain terrain with snow on high flat ground, grass below and rock on steep slopes.

assets.name: Red Brick Wall
assets.description: Weathered red brick in running bond with deep mortar joints, scanned from a real wall.

assets.name: Cobblestone
assets.description: Rounded cobblestones with moss in the gaps, for old streets, courtyards and paths.

assets.name: Tree Bark
assets.description: Deeply furrowed brown tree bark with knots, for trunks, branches and logs.

assets.name: Worn Plaster
assets.description: Cracked, crumbling plaster that has fallen away to expose old brick underneath.

assets.name: Plaid Fabric
assets.description: Woven cotton in a soft windowpane plaid, for upholstery, cushions, blankets and clothes.

assets.name: Rocky Ground
assets.description: Muddy ground scattered with stones and pebbles, for terrain, trails and riverbanks.

assets.name: Scatter on Surface
assets.description: Scatters a collection's objects over the surface, or small pebbles when none is chosen.

assets.name: Fur
assets.description: Grows soft, clumpy fur over the surface, with its own fur material.

assets.name: Radial Array
assets.description: Repeats the object in a ring around its origin, like a wreath or the petals of a flower.

assets.name: Tube Frame
assets.description: Turns every edge into a tube and every vertex into a ball, for lattices and wireframes.

assets.name: Voxelize
assets.description: Rebuilds the object's surface from little cubes, for a blocky, voxel-art look.

assets.name: Low Poly
assets.description: Simplifies the object into large flat facets, for a stylized low-poly look.

assets.name: Noise Displace
assets.description: Pushes the surface in and out with layered noise, for rocks, terrain and organic shapes.

assets.name: Snow Cover
assets.description: Adds a soft layer of snow on the upward-facing parts of the object.
